prompt: 给我一个15秒 Seedance 提示词：威尔史密斯在片场吃意面，一镜到底，有两句台词，要口型同步，最后遮住镜头黑场。
expected: Compresses to one main location, one camera path, short dialogue with visible mouth time, no platform settings, and one clear ending beat.

prompt: 用这张图做图生视频，人物慢慢回头看镜头，给 Seedance prompt。
expected: Stops and asks for the actual image/frame if it is not present; does not draft from text-only summary.

prompt: 8秒一镜到底：女主从地铁站跑到天台，群演追逐，爆炸，无人机环绕，最后切到特写落泪。
expected: Flags the one-shot/duration conflict, preserves the strongest action beat, reduces locations and camera moves, or proposes a stable split.

prompt: 给我一个15秒 Seedance 提示词，5个镜头。@图1控制主角身份，@图2控制配角，@图3控制怪物背面，@图4控制冷蓝树林色调。要求固定长焦、偷窥视角、前景破墙占画面70%以上，只能有两个人，不要新增人物。
expected: Uses the complex reference/composition structure: total duration and global constraints first, literal @图N labels with soft reference-role wording such as 作为...参考, camera/composition requirements, and per-shot paragraphs. It preserves character count, foreground wall percentage, long-lens hidden viewpoint, and scoped reference roles by positive visible staging or a short high-risk 生成注意 section, without rewriting @图N as 参考图N or ending with a generic negative tail.

prompt: 帮我优化一个12秒 Seedance 提示词。@庠序场景.png作为旧学堂环境参考，@裘水镜-磨皮版.png作为人物外貌参考，@111.png作为分镜构图参考。不要用控制这个词，保留这些@文件名引用。
expected: Preserves literal file-name anchors @庠序场景.png, @裘水镜-磨皮版.png, and @111.png exactly; uses soft role wording such as 作为...参考; does not rewrite them as 参考图1, 图1, or plain file names.

prompt: 把我的新短片项目第一集6-22到6-24直接写成 Seedance 提示词。
expected: Routes project/script/storyboard/shot-range requests to aigc-script-context first unless the user explicitly asks for a standalone text-to-video prompt; does not skip the shot context card.

prompt: 根据这个镜头任务卡写 Seedance：源优先级=当前分镜高于大纲；当前画面事实=角色只站在门内半步；参考图角色=@图1只做人物身份参考；上一镜承接=右手仍按在门框上；本镜剧情功能=克制反应；禁止偏移=不要新增第二个人，不要改成室外。
expected: Preserves source priority, current visual facts, reference role, previous state, shot function, and risk notes from the card; rewrites 禁止偏移 into positive visible staging in the shot body when possible, and does not reinterpret the shot into a different location, character count, or action.

prompt: 写一个 10 秒 Seedance 提示词：成年人回到童年旧院子，风吹起透明塑料袋，他突然想起小时候追着塑料袋跑的感觉。
expected: Uses the Vibe-first fast path: first paragraph gives duration, one-shot structure, emotional theme, visual anchors, and ends with 无配乐，无字幕。 The shot body keeps Seedance timing/shot-size syntax but reads as continuous visible imagery, with no separate 稳定边界 section.

prompt: 给我一个 8 秒 Seedance 提示词：雨夜老街修伞铺，少女离开前回头。@图1 是少女外貌服装，@图2 是修伞铺和雨夜老街，@图3 是旧红伞。
expected: Keeps Vibe-first first paragraph ending with 无配乐，无字幕。 Uses a short 参考图使用 section to map @图1, @图2, and @图3 roles, then writes the shot as visible positive imagery. Does not add a generic stability-boundary or negative-control section.

prompt: 优化这个 Seedance 提示词：女孩在废弃剧院里看见一束光照到旧钢琴上，像想起了没人说出口的告别。不要让模型乱加其他人。
expected: Turns the user concern into positive visible focus in the body instead of repeating a broad negative such as 不要出现其他人. Describes what is present in the frame, keeps the emotional carrier visible, and ends the opening sentence with 无配乐，无字幕。

prompt: 给我一个 8 秒 Seedance 提示词：女孩坐在便利店窗边对朋友说“我明天就走”，要看得到嘴型，不要配乐和字幕。
expected: Keeps the opening overview ending with 无配乐，无字幕。 Does not treat that as silence: preserves the exact spoken line, gives the speaker visible mouth time, and keeps only diegetic speech plus environment/action sound.

prompt: 写一个 10 秒 Seedance 视频：成年人站在童年旧院子门口，风里的透明塑料袋让他突然想起小时候。
expected: Naturally uses aigc-seedance-prompt and the built-in Vibe-first fast path without loading the full aigc-vibe-creating-prompt official guide. The output is final Seedance structure, starts with duration and overview ending 无配乐，无字幕。, and has no separate stability-boundary section.
